H1.quote: Diet trial (owner-entered): Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Dry and 5 other trial foods, from Jul 26, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026, planned for 84 days.
H1.why: The trial is given as a plain date span with no adherence information and no note that it is not a test of the diet alone. A hurried reader could take it as a completed, followed trial. The 'owner-entered' label and 'planned' keep it from claiming adherence.

H2.why: The vomiting and trial sentences sit side by side but state no change, improvement, or attribution.

H3.why: The summary does not mention the refusals, so it neither softens them nor swaps the refusal count for the partial count. Band item 2 prints above it.

H4.why: Nothing absent or unlogged is presented as normal or clear.

H5.quote: Vomiting: 16 entries on 12 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 31.
H5.why: The logged-day denominator is kept, but the window (Sep 16 onward) is not stated. The log starts well after the Jul 26 trial start, so the count could be read as covering the whole trial. The line's '14 episodes as the flag counts them' is also dropped.

H6.why: Every stated fact traces to the band or the record lines.

H7.quote: Vomiting: 16 entries on 12 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 31.
H7.why: This flat tally reads as intermittent. It leaves out that 6 of the entries fall in the last 7 days on 3 days in a row, and that the pattern is chronic over at least 44 days, so band items 3 and 5 are made to look calmer and more spread out. The band prints above the summary, so a careful reader may still catch it.
